black-skimmer.name: Black Skimmer
marks: black cap down to eye level; white lower face, throat and breast
bill red-orange on the base 55%, black tip
lower mandible clearly longer than upper; bill blade-thin, angled slightly down
black back
black-skimmer.notes: Keep the design of the base icon. Make the dark outer part of the bill Klein blue (#002FA7) instead of navy.

american-kestrel.name: American Kestrel
marks: two dark vertical face stripes: one below the eye, one behind it on the ear
blue-grey crown with a small rufous spot
white cheeks and throat
rufous nape and back
yellow eye-ring and cere
small hooked bill
american-kestrel.notes: No Klein blue anywhere. Exactly two dark vertical face stripes: one below the eye, one behind it on the ear. A slate-grey crown (slate #5E6178) with a small rufous spot, white cheeks and throat, rufous nape and back, a yellow eye-ring and a small hooked bill.

brown-pelican.name: Brown Pelican
marks: very long flat bill with a small hook at the tip
dark throat pouch under the bill, slim when closed
white head with a pale yellow crown
dark chestnut-black hindneck; white stripe down the foreneck
pale eye in a pink-red bare patch
avoid: any plume or crest on the head
brown-pelican.notes: Use the bill and pouch of the first base icon with the clearer eye of the second. Keep the shapes simple enough to read at 64 px. No plume or crest.

northern-bobwhite.name: Northern Bobwhite
marks: white eyebrow from the bill over the eye to the nape
black stripe through the eye, running down the neck
large white throat bordered by black below
dark crown with a small, low peak at the back, not a plume
short stout bill
rufous-brown body with black and white mottling on the neck
avoid: a tall plume or topknot (that is a California or Gambel's quail)

eastern-screech-owl.name: Eastern Screech-Owl
marks: short triangular ear tufts
compact, nearly square head on a compact body
facial discs rimmed dark at the sides
yellow eyes
small pale bill between the eyes
grey plumage
avoid: tall ear tufts like a Great Horned Owl
heart-shaped face (that is a barn owl)
eastern-screech-owl.notes: Face straight ahead, fully symmetric. Eyes: a yellow iris ring around a large black pupil, both eyes exactly the same size, each with a dark brow line over it that gives the stern look of the attached photo. Short ear tufts angled outward, a streaked crown, facial discs rimmed dark, a small pale bill, and a pale breast with dark vertical streaks. Slate-grey plumage.

great-blue-heron.name: Great Blue Heron
marks: long straight dagger bill, yellow
black stripe above the eye running back into a long plume
white face and crown centre
long S-shaped neck, angled
blue-grey body
great-blue-heron.notes: Combine the bolder head and plume of the first base icon with the long, angular S-shaped neck of the second.

osprey.name: Osprey
marks: white crown
dark stripe from the eye back to the nape
hooked dark bill
white throat and breast
dark brown-black back
yellow eye
at most a small, shaggy crest at the nape
osprey.notes: Only a small, shaggy crest at the back of the head. A dark stripe from the eye back to the nape, white crown and underparts, dark back.

marbled-godwit.name: Marbled Godwit
marks: very long bill, slightly upturned
pink-orange bill base, black outer third
buff-cinnamon head and neck
back marbled with dark bars on buff
marbled-godwit.notes: A buff-cinnamon body marbled with dark bars (chrome yellow with navy marks), not a navy body. Long, slightly upturned bill with a pink-orange base and dark tip.

american-barn-owl.name: American Barn Owl
marks: white heart-shaped facial disc with a buff rim
dark eyes
small pale bill in the middle of the face
pale golden-buff back
white or pale buff front
american-barn-owl.notes: Face straight ahead, fully symmetric. Both eyes exactly the same size: dark eyes (black pupils), each with a short dark brow line over it. A white heart-shaped facial disc with a buff rim, a small pale bill in the middle, a pale golden-buff back and an ivory front. No mismatched eyes, no ear tufts.
